title: Thumbs Up 👍
text: Great place to visit if you have an interest in Roman history.  The mosaics are remarkable and the amphitheater is awesome. Well worth a few hours of your time if you’re in Seville
author: andrewdM4158ZP

title: Great side trip
text: Jesus was an enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide, enjoyed our trip! We didn’t realize the monastery was included but were so glad for the stop there as it was very interesting as well. Would recommend if you have an extra day in Sevilla.
author: Charlestontravelers4

title: Great
text: Very informative. Our guide was very knowledgeable. We went at the right time of day where we could see everything in detail because it wasn’t too busy. The tour company made it was very easy half day trip
author: Abbie_H

title: A must see!
text:
Walking through a Roman city in 2026 is something else!  This is a must see location! 
The tour guide did a great job!   Totally recommend it!
author: Mayra_R

title: Italica - archeological site with beautiful mosaic tiles
text: This tour was a great way to spend a few hours and to learn about the Roman Empire and it's presence in Seville. Our group had two guides - Jesus for the English speakers and Adrian for the Spanish. Jesus was friendly and very entertaining and we certainly didn't get a boring commentary. The mosaic tile designs at Italica are amazing and a must see. After Italica we visited the San Isadiro Monastery which is close by.
author: E4465YImichelleh

title: An excellent way to spend half a day
text: The four hour, half day tour to Italica was a really enjoyable way to see the site. As it it not far for Seville at all, most of the time is spent either at Italica or the monastery. Our tour guide Jesus was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable! He made the trip a lot of fun and well worth the charge.
author: Ash_jay353

title: Superb tour of Italica with Pia
text: We had booked a tour in French, but the day before, due to an insufficient number of people, we had to take the tour in English. Good to know if you do not master English. The guide Pia speaks English very well and we were able to follow the tour without difficulty. Pia is very interesting and gladly answers questions; she made the tour very lively with numerous anecdotes. The bus serves 3 stops, just like on the return trip, very convenient. The tour can extend a little longer than a half-day; be careful not to book anything before 4:00 PM.
author: Companion07867838773

title: Highly recommend
text: Thoroughly enjoyed the tour! The bus was comfortable, with plenty of AC, and my tour guide, Pia, was truly exceptional. She possesses a rare combination of qualities: funny, cheerful, knowledgeable, and incredibly attentive to detail. She made the entire experience both enjoyable and informative. Highly recommended!
author: Wanderer03347980368

title: Pleasant surprise, a safe bet.
text: It exceeded my expectations. Very well organized and coordinated by José Zarapico. From a visit that sounded boring to routine, Alejandro (I am very grateful to you) turned it into a great morning. 100% recommended.
author: soci-a1

title: Very interesting visit.
text: A very interesting visit, with Inés, who was very attentive to the group at all times, and who helped us learn a little more about this important city of Hispania.
